name: super-chart-example-vanilla
description: Minimal vanilla integration example (SC-191): consumes @zzyzxlabs/super-chart through its real package exports (never ../src), and shows the patterns every host still has to write by hand until the React adapter (a later batch) lands — an inline container height, a ResizeObserver calling resize(), a guarded datafeed, an equality guard before setSymbol/setPeriod, and dispose() on teardown.
